svg.title: One DorkOS program in three roles, and the seams between them
svg.desc: The accepted direction of ADR 261015-042933 as of 2026-11-21. One server package runs as a person's computer, a hub or an agent computer, and ships the space server as a fourth entry. Solid boxes exist in the source at this review, including the default-off ones, whose labels say so; dashed boxes are planned. Servers connect by pairing. A Mac's chats reach the web through the session relay. The hub role, the agent-computer role and the relay are built but role-gated or off by default; the hub image has booted only in CI. Nothing here is deployment proof.

div.style: color: rgb(24, 48, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ONE PROGRAM, THREE ROLES · built parts solid, planned parts dashed
Roles are DORKOS_SERVER_ROLE computer / hub / agent-computer
Role-gated or default-off is not deployed
